block.comment: Wait for the given number of milliseconds (1000 ms = 1 second). This pauses the main program; avoid long waits when loop must service motors, music files or serial input.

Purpose: Measure HC-SR04 echo time and print distance to Serial. A missing echo returns -1. Hardware: use Connections to check pin ownership for your selected board. Open the comment bubbles on the main steps for explanations.
